title: Tensor block norm accounting: T114 raises conditional kappa by 5.160482894338e-11
body:
The T114 allocation raises the conditional integer-multiplication κ to 0.0017177952742214166865779999999999999999999998999999999999999999999999, an exact gain of 2580241447169/50000000000000000000000 over the previously delivered T104 package.

The improvement uses the existing whole-family tensor-isomorphism normalization to replace total-call norm growth with eighteen active steps per physical replica. Exact all-column checks in both providers/orientations exclude cross-replica dirty-response leakage and verify cleared private work. Full group-indexed stock conversion is charged: the conservative prefix is1511<2048 and row19547<20161. All1026calls and their children remain paid.

The actual418608-role allocation passed independent chronology/family/capacity/mask checks and exact directed-rational moments. Every changed native-consumer/global/invoice/bootstrap/outer/full-release stage passed freshly; unchanged native chains were authenticated reuse. Fresh Mathlib-only Lean4.34.1 kernel checks cover67 declarations/60 theorems and four real axiom/ownership fixtures, with standard axioms only.

Inherited all-size/compiler/source-access/hosting/precision/tape/recovery/ordinary-recursion/bit-supplier/analytic-transfer hypotheses remain. CREDITS.md and FRONTIER.md identify relevant earlier PRs, including tensor normalization, Schur/gauge/retiming work and the native supplier chain. No general TI algorithm or global novelty claim is made.
